---
applyTo: "app/**,brand/**"
---
Activate `skills/ascot-lloyd-design/SKILL.md` before planning, coding or reviewing any UI, CSS, component, screen, layout, chart, icon or visual content.

`brand/` is the only authoritative source for colours, fonts, logos, icons and imagery. Inspect it first. Never guess or substitute brand values. If an asset is unreadable, report the exact path and stop visual implementation rather than inventing branding.

Centralise brand values in a single token layer. Do not hard-code hex, rgb, hsl or font-family values in page or component files.

Build an operational case-management interface, not a marketing site or generic SaaS dashboard. No gradients, glass effects, glowing backgrounds, neon accents, emoji icons, hero sections, decorative charts, nested rounded cards, excessive shadows or arbitrary animation.

Use domain language: case, check, finding, remediation, owner, due date. Never fabricate records, metrics or compliance outcomes. Label test data clearly.

Target WCAG 2.2 AA (NFR-ACC-01). Cover loading, empty, error, validation, permission and read-only states. Never signal status by colour alone. Visual affordances are presentation only; access control belongs in Dataverse.

State a short design plan before coding and a design verification note after.
